name: B10-0071/2025 (S&D, Verts/ALE) – Situation in Venezuela following the usurpation of the presidency on 10 January 2025
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Venezuela following the usurpation of the presidency on the 10th of January 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament says it does not accept the results of Venezuela's July 2024 presidential election or Nicolás Maduro taking office on 10 January 2025. It asks Venezuela's election authorities to publish all voting records, and calls for the release of all political prisoners. It also asks the European Union to support human rights defenders, keep targeted sanctions on those responsible for repression, and help Venezuelan refugees and migrants. This is the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- What changes: nothing yet; the Parliament is stating demands and positions.
- Who it affects: Venezuela's government, opposition, prisoners, refugees and migrants.
- What happens next: the EU and its member states are asked to act on these calls.
